      SELECT DISTINCT

        df.level
      FROM dependent_fields df
      INNER JOIN field f ON f.id = df.field_id
      WHERE f.type = $2
        AND f.deleted_time IS NULL
      ORDER BY df.level DESC, f.id  -- Deepest dependencies first (topological order)
